about_the_game:
Sweet drinks, sweet machines, sweet chaos!

Cozy Factory is an automation and management game that blends relaxing vibes with the joy of production. Mix a variety of ingredients, set up your machines, and line up your drink recipes! Watching your production line run smoothly will satisfy both you and your customers!

What awaits you in Cozy Factory?

🍓 From Ingredients to Recipes, From Recipes to Bottles Strawberry, cocoa, orange... Use whatever you like! Expand your recipe book and craft drinks to suit every taste.

⚙️ Build, Connect, Watch Pick a recipe, set up your machines, and press the button. Once production starts, it’s not just drinks that will flow but a satisfying sense of progress too.

🏭 From Small Workshop to Sweet Facility Boost your production with new machines. More orders, more variety, more fun!

📬 Demand is High Deliver! Village shops, cozy cafés, special clients… Fulfill orders and turn your earnings into sweet new investments.

🖼️ Style is in Your Hands Colorful drinks, beautifully designed bottles, and a brand that everyone will remember it's all up to you!

Key Features

 ✔ Cheerful and vibrant visuals that are easy on the eyes
✔ Smooth production systems that boost your sense of satisfaction
✔ Handcrafted-feeling drink recipes
✔ Unlockable content and new production options as you progress
✔ Calm gameplay that lets you move at your own pace
✔ Sweet little secrets and cozy references tucked into every corner

Add Cozy Factory to your wishlist so you can be the first to know what's happening!

name: Cozy Factory

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 4.Gen / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / NVIDIA GT 710 / Radeon R5 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Cozy Factory is a relaxing automation sim where you run a sweet drink factory. Stack ingredients, build production lines, and craft colorful recipes. Upgrade machines, boost efficiency, and fill shelves with tasty bottles as you get lost in the cozy flow of production!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Simplified Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Japanese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support
